strongest_angle: On November 5, 2026, the NASA Exoplanet Archive added thirteen newly confirmed transit planets across eleven stellar systems, featuring TOI-1355 b which orbits one of the hottest known Main Sequence planet host stars and whose transits will no longer be observable in seven years.

key_facts.fact: On November 5, 2026, NASA's exoplanet catalog expanded with the addition of thirteen transit-detected planets spread across eleven stellar systems, all bearing the TOI designation.
The November 5, 2026 update features TOI-1355 b, which orbits one of the hottest known Main Sequence planet host stars.
Due to changes in its orbit, the transits of TOI-1355 b will no longer be observable from our perspective in about seven years.
NASA's list of confirmed exoplanets grew by 145 planets since July 15, reaching a total of 6,464 confirmed planets.
